About

About Healthwise.

An exercise and lifestyle management studio in Clonmel since 2011, for people who want to get stronger, stay well, or get moving again after a health event. Three programmes, all coached in groups, with a coach watching every session.

The idea

"Our business is all about adding years to your life and life to your years."

DJ opened Healthwise in 2011 as an exercise and lifestyle management studio: medical exercise for people with chronic conditions, exercise and nutrition programmes, and corporate wellness. In 2013 he added Heartwise, cardiac care for people who have finished hospital rehabilitation and have nowhere to go next.

The approach has not changed. Every programme starts with a conversation, is written for the person rather than the class, and is coached closely enough that nothing is missed.

The coach

What the coaching is built on.

MSc Performance Coaching

Setanta College, 2018 to 2020.

Cardiac rehabilitation

British Association for Cardiovascular Prevention and Rehabilitation, 2014.

Strength and conditioning for sport

Setanta College certificate, 2009 to 2011. NCEF levels 1 and 2 (Dublin City University, University of Limerick).

An Garda Síochána

Thirty years, including five years as fitness instructor and lecturer in physical studies at the Garda College.

Drivewise · for companies

Safer drivers, healthier teams.

Drivewise is Healthwise's driver safety and wellness programme for companies with people on the road: wellness screening, functional movement testing, classroom education and on-road roadcraft evaluation, with confidential personal reports and a corporate summary.

Visit Drivewise Ireland

The programme

Four parts, tailored to the company.

Wellness screening

Body composition, hydration, sleep and cardiovascular checks for each driver.

Functional movement testing

Grip strength, posture and aerobic fitness, with the ergonomics of the driving seat in mind.

Classroom education

Legal compliance, fatigue management and defensive driving.

On-road evaluation

Road, classroom, road again: anticipation, hazard identification and reaction time, coached by an advanced Garda driving instructor.

After a cardiac event

When hospital rehab ends, this is what comes next.

Supervised exercise and lifestyle coaching for people who have had a cardiac procedure and finished their rehabilitation programme, and for people managing type 2 diabetes, blood pressure or weight. Coached, monitored, at a comfortable pace. Since 2013.

Book a consultation

The gap this fills

Rehab is seven weeks. The rest of your life is longer.

After a stent, a bypass or a cardiac event, the hospital programme gets you moving again, and then it ends. Most people are told to keep exercising and sent home to work out how. Heartwise is the room to do it in: coached, monitored, with people who have been through the same thing.

Heartwise is run by a coach certified in cardiac rehabilitation with the British Association for Cardiovascular Prevention and Rehabilitation. Sessions start gently, progress carefully, and pay attention to how you are on the day.

What Heartwise includes

Exercise, and the habits around it.

Coached group exercise

Strength, balance and gentle cardio on the machines, tailored to your history and progressed as you are ready. Never more people than the coach can watch.

Diabetes and blood pressure

Regular exercise supports insulin sensitivity and healthy blood pressure. We coach the movement and the habits around it, alongside your GP's care, never instead of it.

Confidence back

Trust in your body is rebuilt the same way strength is: gradually, with steady wins, and with someone paying attention.

Bring your discharge letter and your questions. We'll take it from there.

Livewell · 40 to 60

Strong, mobile and awake, in the years that decide the next thirty.

For working adults and parents between 40 and 60: the decade where muscle quietly goes, sleep gets shorter, and the aches start being called "age". Five coached classes a week, mornings and evenings, so it fits around a job.

Book a consultation

Who it is for

People who have noticed the change and want to get ahead of it.

Livewell is for anyone aged 40 to 60 who is starting to feel the early signs: stiffness in the morning, less energy in the afternoon, weight that is harder to shift than it used to be, a back that complains after a day at a desk or in a van.

Nothing here is extreme. Every class is coached, the loads are set for you, and the point is to build the strength, mobility and cardiovascular fitness that keep you independent and sharp for the next thirty years, not to leave you flattened for the next three days.

The classes

Five coached classes a week.

Pick the ones that suit you. Times are on the timetable.

Women's Cardio Tone

Cardio on the rowers, ski ergs, bikes and steppers, with light weights and bands for lean tone. Fifty-five minutes.

Mornings from 7am and evenings from 6pm

MoveWell Strength for Women

Strength training designed around menopause: targeted work to hold on to muscle and bone density through the years that take them fastest.

Men's Gym

Structured resistance training for lean muscle, with a cardiovascular finish on the rowers, ski ergs and bikes. Fifty minutes.

Mornings from 7am

Women's MoveWell Mobility

Flexibility, range of movement around the joints, and the guided stretching that takes the edge off common aches and pains.

Women's Circuit

A circuit of strength and aerobic stations for lean muscle tone and a stronger heart, coached the whole way round.

What you get from it

Independence and mobility, kept. Stress and sleep, improved.

Studio 60 · 60 and over

Still strong. Still training. Still going.

Coached strength and conditioning for men and women over 60. Free weights, machines and conditioning work, coached in a group, at a level that suits you.

Book a consultation

What a session actually is

Real training, sized for the person doing it.

Studio 60 is for people over 60, whether you train already or are starting out. Sessions use free weights and the machines, with conditioning work alongside, and the load goes up as you get stronger.

A coach is in the room throughout, watching the movement and adjusting the weight. Nothing here is a class you follow from the back row.

Who comes

This is for you if any of these sound familiar.

You already train, and you want it coached

You walk, you cycle, you have used a gym before. What you want is a programme and somebody watching the technique, not a room full of machines and a guess.

You want to lift properly

Real weight, progressed sensibly. Strength is the thing that holds off most of what people fear about getting older, and it responds at any age.

You are starting out

You haven't trained in a while, or ever. The coach starts you at a level that suits you and builds from there.

You want to keep doing what you do

Golf, hills, the garden, lifting grandchildren. The point of the training is the life outside it, and the programme is written around what you want to keep.

Build

Strength and power. Bone and muscle. Stamina that lasts the day.
